system.description:
When you have a moment to treat a creature within Melee range, make an Interface Roll (12). On a success, choose one:
• The target clears 1 Stress.
• The target clears a temporary physical condition, such as Vulnerable, or Restrained.
• The target stabilizes a damaged implant, life-support system, or cyberware component until their next rest.

Once per rest, when you succeed on this roll, the target can clear 1 Hit Point in addition of choosing one of the effects above. A creature can clear a Hit Point from Emergency Medicine only once per rest.
